# seg03 — notes (VO 206.27–296.23, SC035–SC047)

**Source of truth:** `compositions/seg03.html` is generated by `work/seg03/src/gen_seg03.py` from
`work/seg03/src/seg03_template.tpl`. The script fills in the US map paths (West/East regions, state lines, Mississippi)
from `assets/maps/us_overlay.json`. Edit the template and re-run `python3 work/seg03/src/gen_seg03.py`, or edit the
generated file directly if the template is no longer needed.

## Deviations / decisions
- SC035: subtitle is `charging a little bit` (exact VO words) and the AFTER-bar label is `for classes` (@213.71 "for"),
  instead of the planned `charging for classes` + `classes`, which repeated the same word twice.
- SC041 kicker reads `the second thing` (spoken words) instead of `change no. 2`.
- SC045: only the strike-through. No added "not", because the VO says "wasn't".
- A18 (early GSB image) is missing. Both GSB cards use the Stanford arcade c.1920 plate (`stanford_arcade_c1920_quad1921.jpg`), tinted and halftoned. SC044's early card is tagged `1925`.
- SC047 layers: the shipped `students_back.png` had a jagged polygon top edge cutting through heads, and dark inpaint smudges that showed around the front row. I made `assets/derived/seg03/students_back_soft.png` from the original photo pixels. It has a smooth feathered top ramp (a depth-of-field fade into the blurred backdrop), and a blurred original fills in behind the front row. `students_front_soft.png` is the same matte, slightly feathered. Both layers are graded identically, so the resting frame is seamless.
- Downsized working copies (≤2400 px, pano 7074×1200) are in `assets/derived/seg03/` (see SOURCES.md there).
- Stanford map pin: vermilion dot with a bone ring and a yellow halo (West accent plus the shared yellow ring).
- sync_audit flags 12 cues. All of them are structural (camera moves, arrows, exits, light leak), apart from the small secondary label
  `Stanford, Calif.` (+0.14 s after "here"). Every narrated text cue lands 0–60 ms before its word.
